notes.title: JKGirlSamurai2.5 UpDate
notes.content:
1. The staircase has been updated. You can go up the staircase by pressing the direction keys simultaneously. If you only press the direction keys, you won't go up the staircase.

2. Add full-screen pixel comics of important dialogues.

3. New teaching levels have been added, and a new character, "Kendo Teacher", has been introduced.

4. At the beginning of the game, Kui Wen doesn't have any weapons and needs to get them.

5. Modify the visual effect of the triple slash and increase the retraction time of the third slash.

6. Adjust the smoothness of the attack.

7. Fixed the sound issue when occasionally consuming items.

8. A new loading button has been added to the start interface, and a background volume setting has been added to the Settings.

9. Modify the level name and story content.

10. Modify the enemy's health points. In the third level, the return of the darkened sister's Yan will release bats.

11. The UI system has been modified.

notes.title: JKGirlSamurai - Aoi 2.2 update
notes.content:
1. Added save points in the level. After the character dies, the save point will be returned. After exiting the level, the save data in the level will be cleared, but the level save data will not be cleared.
2. Added sprint skills. Press J to sprint while running.
3. The original third attack is changed to a static state. When the combo reaches the third stage, press the direction key to trigger the sprint attack.
4. The flash of God is changed to consume only 3 grids of energy.
5. Modified the character's attack speed, the time of forward and backward swing, and shortened the enemy's attack range.
6. Increased the number of enemies in some areas.
7. Each gold coin is 20, and each gold bag is 50.
8. Added snow guidance and modified the distance of several stairs.
9. Modified the game screen to an old filter.
